checks.label: Empty state has one composer, one discoverable history entry, no default focus/scope chip or permanent chat panel, and an editable untitled research name
Ordinary explanation stays in a collapsible short answer; viewing history does not erase it or create an artifact
A new empty research adds the three explicitly synthetic sources with one adoption action
Start creates editable results directly, stopping preserves completed parts, continuing finishes without duplicate rows or a second input
1440×900, 1280×800 and 1024×800 have no document overflow; the single input stays visible and the narrow navigation is an accessible drawer
Only an explicit local ask sets a visible target; browsing does not change it, sending consumes it, and explanation questions containing revision words do not mutate results
A long input collapses the bounded short answer, preserves a usable work area at 1024px, and native text undo is not hijacked
Citation opens the one reference region; deep reading has an explicit return target and restores the exact comparison scroll position and selected item
Manual edits retain source labels; revisions show inline differences, stale proposals cannot overwrite new edits, and apply/undo/keep preserve user text
One library adoption associates the source without repeated steps; metadata-only sources cannot pretend to have full text; search retrieves old cards, whiteboards and drafts
The canvas combines content cards, a source and a shape without a card/drawing mode switch; local ask uses the same composer
History stays a read-only temporary reference, and the current draft exports through one object action
No JavaScript errors, external requests, persistent-storage reads or writes occurred
Completing a run while reading preserves the central source page and offers a one-line result link instead of stealing focus

limitations: Fixed synthetic examples; no real model, tool loop, external search, PDF, or research quality verification.
Page memory only; reload resets this isolated prototype.
Canvas offers a fixed mixed example and simple additions, not a production drawing engine.
